title: No debugger: the reference plant drives the TON's input, sees the program's TIME() as its own virtual time, and sees Q at 5 s of virtual time
notes: Plant drive and observation only, so it runs against plc_main with the reference plant and no debug endpoint (tests/debug/plant/e2e.sh). The halt half of A152 is plant-schedule-halt.

steps.note: the program's TIME() (%QD2) and the plant's virtual time agree within one interval
